reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, round-5 fix-verification batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: An object measures 21 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 2 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 14 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 3 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?
An object measures 18 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: I hand-verified all 8 seeds: 21->20, 2->0, 14->10, 9->10, 3->0, 12->10, 18->20, 3->0; every one matches standard round-half-up, and critically the seed-43 case (2 cm) previously reported wrong (answered 10) now correctly answers 0.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All 8 seeds (42-49) use centimeters only ('An object measures X cm'); the competency explicitly names both meters and centimeters for length plus meters for distance, and none of those appear anywhere in this batch.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The sentence 'An object measures 21 cm. About how many cm is that, rounded to the nearest 10?' is two short clauses, matching the reading level expected of a Grade 2 Quarter 2 student who has already met nearest-ten rounding.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only one dna ('length_measurement') and one item shape back this node; combined with the missing meter/distance items noted above, the registered variant space does not yet plausibly cover the full 'meters or centimeters, and distance using meters' scope of this lc.

competency_alignment.rationale: Framing a measured centimeter value and asking the student to round it to the nearest ten is a legitimate estimation task and does align with 'Estimate length using meters or centimeters', it just under-represents the meters half of that same sentence.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Object lengths of 2-21 cm are small, everyday classroom-object magnitudes appropriate for Grade 2, and the previously-reported small-value rounding bug (values under 5 wrongly rounding up to 10 instead of down to 0) is confirmed fixed in seeds 43 and 46.
